active_objective: Acquire reusable professional intelligence for frontend/UI/UX, art direction/lookdev, and semantic engineering, then prove transfer on bounded evidence.
non_goals: claiming professional mastery from packs or scripts
adding tools without a verified capability gap

proofs.result: browser-game intent expands to frontend, game, accessibility, responsive, motion, runtime, and performance disciplines

complete evidence is accepted without artistic certification; score-only and missing-state cases are blocked
W3C WCAG 2.2/APG, web.dev Web Vitals, Playwright, Blender 5.2, Epic UE 5.8, Python/TypeScript/LSP sources recorded with date and URL

current_truth.engineering: existing Foundry has broad verified infrastructure

stop_conditions: stop when declared capability question and transfer test are answered
stop if work becomes product construction rather than capability acquisition
stop and replan when the mission value gate returns STOP_AND_REPLAN

actual image/video payload model benchmark for creative roles
source freshness and just-in-time knowledge expiry
